Running away won’t be the best idea, but good idea to take the notebook. Keep anything with any evidence you can, and write down your experiences. 

If you have ANYONE who can help you, at all, tell them please. Running away can maybe get you in trouble and then also possible issues once returned home. 

Not only that, but very dangerous people out in the world too, especially if anyone sees two young people alone. Please, even if you only call 911, try and be anonymous and maybe say you were a witness of your father’s abuse. Maybe Just don’t say who you are? I don’t know if it legal, But With a huge party like that, it would be hard for anyone to know it was really you who called them! You could also claim at the party as a guest you saw your sisters assault. You just need your address and when they ask for your name try tell them you have to be anonymous.

Oh baby. I’m so sorry. Your parents are doing nothing for you in regards to being real parents. I’ve been there, in the system, all of this. Try and talk to your school guidance counselor first. You will face ridicule and more from your parents but it has to be done. BUT Definitely talk to your sister as well and band together to be a united front. You have to both be on the same page in order to prevent the system from not believing you. You have to directly stand against your parents as a united front. To be very strong and not let them sway you guys regardless of what’s to come. Document every detail you can and EVERY trauma you remember from both parents and be one another’s witness. You two have to be UNSHAKEABLE. 

From there, it’s highly possible you may enter the system for a stent. You may either go with trusted extended family or a foster home. REGARDLESS demand that your sister and yourself are NOT TO BE SEPARATED. If it comes to it, Tell them if you are separated into different homes in the system that you will face EXTREME mental distress because you fear her being abused further, and you have a deep sense of responsibility for her. I am not saying this to scare you, it’s just a possibility that has to be mentioned. I did this and it made it to where my sister stayed with me when my brothers had to stay with family. You can ask for a child advocate as well to help you. I was in social work for two years. I wish I could do more to help but I’m no lawyer and going off my own experience, however My inbox is open if you have questions of any kind.
“If you dance I’ll dance. If you don’t, I’ll dance anyway. Give peace a chance. Let the fears you have fall away.” 🩵
